The dashboard now pre-renders its heading, section labels, and space-reserving placeholders while the API-backed content streams through a [Suspense boundary](/workspace/app/page.tsx:28). The page and route loading state share the same [dashboard skeleton](/workspace/app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx:1).

I enabled partial prefetching alongside Cache Components and restored Next.js 16, which the app’s original configuration requires. `npm run build` succeeds and reports `/` as a **Partial Prerender**. I also checked that the generated HTML contains the shell before the data loads.

The dashboard data still depends on the existing `api.example.com` placeholder endpoint; this change does not supply a live API.
